units.speaker: Anna
units.text: Hello, and welcome to a short walk.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: And I'm Ben. This is Chicago on a Thursday in early December, in three stops.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: And it's a work day, so it's a walk in pieces.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: Right. First piece is the lunch hour.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: Stops one and two, on the way to a pizza lunch.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: Second piece is later, after dinner, when you wander to a nightcap.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: The pause button is the star of every one of these walks.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: Okay, I'll make a bet. By the end of this walk, somebody will say "that's just a bridge."

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: And I'll tell you why it isn't.
